reason: A proposes a directly testable pre-oxidation intervention with a generally sound alumina-barrier mechanism and clear baseline comparison and falsification criteria, although success will depend on sufficient Al activity and compatibility with top-coat deposition. B invokes the established reactive-element effect, but incorrectly centers it on forming a continuous Hf-rich protective scale, while its relatively high Hf range and unsupported 20% lifetime threshold risk HfO2/internal-oxidation damage and weaken the proposal.
